question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping is free on orders of ₹499 and above. Orders below ₹499 carry a shipping fee of ₹70.
keywords: shipping charges cost fee free delivery charge minimum order

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Orders are usually dispatched within 1-2 business days. Delivery typically takes 2-5 business days to metro cities and 4-8 business days to other locations, depending on the pincode.
keywords: delivery time how long days dispatch when arrive pincode shipping speed

question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
answer: Cash on Delivery is available on eligible pincodes for orders up to ₹10,000. A COD handling fee of ₹40 applies.
keywords: cod cash on delivery pay at door cash

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, popular wallets, and Cash on Delivery on eligible pincodes. EMI is not offered at this time.
keywords: payment methods options upi card credit debit net banking wallet pay emi instalments installments

question: What is the return policy?
answer: Most products can be returned within 15 days of delivery if they are unused, sealed and in their original packaging. For hygiene reasons, opened or used beauty products cannot be returned unless they were received damaged, defective or incorrect.
keywords: return returns policy window days unused sealed opened used eligible

question: How do I raise a return request?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item and choose Return. Our courier partner will schedule a pickup, and a quality check is done once the item reaches our warehouse.
keywords: how to return raise request pickup steps process

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are initiated after the returned item passes the quality check. Prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method within 5-7 business days. COD orders are refunded to your Nykaa wallet or bank account.
keywords: refund refunds timeline when money back wallet bank credited

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel an order from My Orders any time before it is shipped. Once it has shipped, cancellation isn't possible, but you may be able to return the item under the return policy.
keywords: cancel cancellation cancellations cancel order before shipped

question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong product?
answer: Please report it within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the product and packaging. A specialist will review it and arrange a replacement or refund.
keywords: damaged broken leaking wrong item missing defective report

question: Are your products authentic?
answer: All products are sourced directly from brands or their authorised distributors.
keywords: authentic genuine original real fake counterfeit sourced

question: Can I exchange a product for a different shade or size?
answer: Direct exchanges aren't available. You can return an eligible unused product under the return policy and place a new order for the shade or size you want.
keywords: exchange shade size swap replace different

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: At present we deliver only within India.
keywords: international overseas abroad outside india ship countries

question: Do you have gift wrapping?
answer: Gift wrapping isn't available for online orders at this time.
